notes: Unity Ludum Dare 48 entry Light 'em Up. Top-down lab defense: place cables and turrets, fight enemies, with Menu/Help/Game/GameOver scenes. MIT (copyright 2021 Deseteral <deseteral@gmail.com>). Playable on itch.io (https://deseteral.itch.io/light-em-up). Font Assets/Fonts/slkscr.ttf is Silkscreen (SIL OFL; no separate OFL.txt in-repo). WAV SFX included under the MIT grant. No EXE/DLL/LFS/Mannequin/InsertPack/StarterContent/EmojiOne/TMP assets/AssetStore. ~7.5MB src snapshot.
